description: Route user messages to the right worker using a decision model (Clef, Jev, or any SystemOne-compatible endpoint). Supports local sidecar, Cloudflare Workers AI, and custom endpoints.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: How to connect to the decision model

fields.label: Endpoint URL
fields.description: Local: http://127.0.0.1:8710/v1/systemone. Custom: your endpoint URL.

fields.label: Model
fields.description: Model ID. Built-in: clef-flash, clef. SiliconFlow: Kev-4b. Or any SystemOne-compatible model ID.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: API key for custom endpoints (e.g. SiliconFlow). Sent as Bearer token. Leave empty for local sidecar.

fields.label: Confidence Threshold
fields.description: Minimum confidence (0-1) to auto-route. Below this, the agent decides. Default: 0.85

fields.label: Enable auto-routing
fields.description: When enabled, incoming messages are routed through the decision model before the agent sees them

systemPromptFragments.text: The `decide` tool uses a fast decision model for classification, routing, and yes/no judgments. Much faster and cheaper than reasoning through options yourself. Use it when you need a quick structured decision with probabilities.

toolGroups.description: Fast decision model for classification, routing, and structured judgments
